contenders.handicapper_notes: Clear standout on raw figures after delivering a high speed rating of 76 on debut when 3rd beaten only 0.6 lengths at Kembla Grange over 1300m. Resumes here with two sharp conditioning trials under his belt. Benefits from an ideal low barrier draw in gate 2 and retains top metro rider Zac Lloyd for local trainer Brad Widdup. Maps for an uncontested stalking trip just off the speed.

Scratches leave this filly as the uncontested early front-runner, triggering the Post-Scratch Lone Speed bonus (+6). Showed sharp early foot last start when pressing forward and leading at the turn over 1250m at Muswellbrook before boxing on for 5th. Well-seasoned race fitness gives her a significant advantage to pinch an easy lead on the Good 4 surface.

First starter by top sire The Autumn Sun out of Australian Oaks winner Once Were Wild. Hails from the astute Sara Ryan stable and has trialled satisfactorily in open provincial heats. Has the pedigree and staying scope to appreciate kicking off at 1300m on a fair circuit.

Strikes third-up physical peak after an improved 6th beaten 3.2 lengths over 1100m at this track where he earned a career-best 62 speed rating. Steps up to 1300m and lands the inside rail barrier 1, allowing jockey Jeff Penza to secure soft economical cover behind the leaders.

Caught the eye running on from the tail of the field to finish 5th beaten 2.25 lengths over 1100m at Hawkesbury last start. Suited by the step up to 1300m and draws favorably in gate 3 to settle closer in the run.

Best run of the campaign was two starts back when finishing runner-up over this course and distance on soft going. Drops back into provincial maiden handicap company but must overcome a tricky wide barrier gate.

contenders.handicapper_notes: Chris Waller trained colt dropping back from a high-rating Tier 1 mid-week metro Super Maiden at Kensington over 1550m where he stormed home from last to finish 4th beaten just 2.1 lengths. Qualifies for the Class Drop Bonus and is tailor-made for Hawkesbury spacious 380m uphill run-home. James McDonald takes the reins from low gate. Canonical style code S.

Gai Waterhouse and Adrian Bott trained filly who showed genuine metropolitan class last start at Warwick Farm over 1400m, setting the pace and boxing on tenaciously for 4th beaten only 1.4 lengths. Drops in grade to provincial company, carrying a featherweight 55kg (121 lbs) under Rachel King. Presser profile (P) who will look to take command early.

Produced an encouraging debut effort at this track and distance bracket over 1400m on September 5, tracking on-pace and sticking on for 3rd behind Unbridled Storm. Open to substantial physical progression second-up for the Hawkes stable with Tyler Schiller retaining the mount. Canonical style code P.

Second Waller runner with upside, stepping up to 1500m second-up after an even 5th over 1300m here when resuming. Boasts heavy-track Group/Open 2yo form from last prep and is bred to relish this distance test by Castelvecchio. Danger horse lurking at attractive each-way value with Zac Lloyd aboard. Canonical style code S.

Honest Toronado mare from the Joseph Pride yard who is rarely far away, having placed in four of five career starts. Tracked the speed and ran 2nd over 1400m at Goulburn last time out, though safely held by 7 lengths. Wide gate is neutralized on the spacious Hawkesbury circuit, but faces sharper 3yo rivals here. Canonical style code P.

Fitter for two runs back from a spell, improving slightly to finish 6th beaten 4.5 lengths over 1300m at Hawkesbury on September 10. Drawn the inside barrier which aids soft run, but lacks the acceleration of the top tier contenders. Canonical style code C.

Well set up to get the run of the race behind the lone leader.
